# v1.5.0 — 2026-10-14

Changes since v1.4.0.

## New features

- **CSV export.** You can now export data as CSV. (2ea1e66)

## Bug fixes

- **Parser:** empty input no longer causes problems in the parser. (bc94018)
- **Reports:** reports now use the configured timezone. (51ac5ee)

## Documentation

- Clarified the install steps. (f96f712)

## Maintenance

- Bumped dev dependencies. These don't affect runtime behavior. (0828f0b)
